Benchmark is the Nifty 500 price index (dividends not included). Idle cash earns 6.5% a year (a liquid fund), taxed at the 30% slab in the tax estimate; Sharpe ratios, for the strategy and the benchmark, count only returns above that rate.
rules: Enter at the close of the first session of a month when the stock's residual momentum rank is in the top 10% of the universe. Residual momentum: over the daily returns from 251 to 21 sessions ago, the stock's return minus beta x Nifty 500's, summed and divided by its standard deviation (Blitz, Huij and Martens 2011, on the market model). No trend or market-regime filter.
Stop 4 x ATR(14) below the signal close; skip if that is more than 20% away.
Universe: the daily scan's (EQ series, close >= ₹20, 20-day median turnover >= ₹5 crore, not on GSM/ASM, 200 sessions of history).
Buy at the next open if it is at or below the signal close + 0.5 x ATR. Skip if it opens above that, opens below the stop, or is locked at the upper circuit.
No entry in a stock in a 2% or 5% price band that day (it can lock at the lower circuit for days).
Book half at +3R, stop to breakeven at +1R (closing basis), trail the rest by 4 x ATR(14) on closing basis, exiting at the next open.

Size: 1% of equity at risk (halved when Nifty 50 is below its 200-day EMA or VIX is in its top decile, halved again in a 10% drawdown), at most 20% of equity and 1% of 20-day average volume; no new entries above 6% total open risk or for 20 sessions after a 15% drawdown.
Most candidates on a day go to the highest tech-v1 score first.
Sell at the next open after the first session of a month on which the stock's residual momentum rank is below 0.75 (out of the top quarter).
Invest: exit if not +1R within 250 sessions.
